description: This file defines the class 'OneToManyRelationship', which manages metadata related to one-to-many relationships in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM framework. It handles building subpanel definitions, vardefs, layout fields, and relationship metadata for such relationships within the module system.

classes.name: OneToManyRelationship
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractRelationship to implement metadata management for one-to-many relationships between modules in SuiteCRM. It provides methods for constructing subpanels, vardefs, layout fields, and relationship metadata specific to these relationship types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an instance with the provided relationship definition, delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Builds and returns definitions for subpanels related to the one-to-many relationship, unless only the relationship metadata is needed.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Constructs vardef array entries, including link and relate fields, for the modules involved in the relationship.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Defines which fields should be added to module layouts, typically related to the relationship's name.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Generates and returns the relationship metadata definition for the module.
